entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by a UE after requesting release of the 5GMM context by starting the de-registration procedure and waiting for a response from the network.

entities.name: De-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to request release of the 5GMM context.

entities.name: Waiting for network response
entities.description: Condition where the UE is waiting for a response from the network after initiating de-registration.

relations.description: Starting the de-registration procedure causes the UE to enter the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state.
The 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state requires the condition of waiting for a network response.
